app.title: Farm visits
setup.title: Set up the app
setup.body: The first time, the models must be downloaded (≈ 1.1 GB) over Wi-Fi. After that the app works without internet.
consent.title: Visitor consent
consent.showVisitor: Show this screen to the visitor
consent.needRecording: Recording is not possible without recording consent
processing.title: Processing the review
detail.title: Review
detail.truncated: The audio was longer than 60 s; only the first minute was processed
detail.noReply: Not sure what they ask for; no suggested reply
received.title: WhatsApp message
received.howto: In WhatsApp, press and hold the visitor's voice note or message, tap Share and choose this app.
received.pasteText: Or paste the English message here
reply.title: Reply
reply.noPhone: No saved number: you will pick the contact in WhatsApp
reply.sentNote: WhatsApp opened. With no signal, WhatsApp sends it when the connection returns.
reply.editQu: Review and correct the Quechua before sending
reply.doubtfulQu: Not sure about these parts; correct them if needed
slot.maps: Google Maps link to the farm
insights.title: Visitors say
lock.title: Enter your PIN
lock.forgotBody: Without the PIN you can only delete all data and start again.
settings.title: Settings
settings.deleteBody: All reviews, visitors, replies and the PIN on this phone will be deleted. This cannot be undone.
settings.privacy: Everything stays on this phone only. The app does not send data to the internet.
home.photo.sub: Take a photo of the visit.
home.offline.sub: Your data is stored on this device.
consent.askConsent: Ask for their consent before recording the review.
ob.lead: Turn your visitors' voices into ideas for your farm.
ob.step2.sub: The app gathers the topics that matter most for your farm.
ob.step3.sub: Receive and answer your visitors' WhatsApp messages.
ob.offline.sub: Use the app on your farm, even with no signal.
ob.offlineLead: The first time, the app downloads its models (≈ 1.1 GB) over Wi-Fi. After that everything runs on your phone, without internet.
ob.private.sub: Reviews stay on this phone, protected by your PIN.
ob.langLead: You can change it anytime from the home screen.
setup.waiting: No connection. The download continues on its own when the signal returns; nothing downloaded is lost.
